unit: Center on the Developing Child (Harvard HGSE)

labs.lab_name: Center on the Developing Child at Harvard University
labs.research_summary: A multi-disciplinary center founded in 2006 that turns early childhood science into resources for policy and practice, aimed at better outcomes for young children facing adversity.
labs.join_notes: Staff roles are applied for only through Harvard Careers (search 'Center on the Developing Child'); materials sent elsewhere are not reviewed. No staff or student openings at the time of the cached page. Speculative applicants may email a resume and cover letter to developingchild_EDIB@harvard.edu.
labs.notes: Senior leadership includes two co-executive directors. Founding director, affiliated faculty and center fellows are on separate pages and not counted. No general contact email, phone or address shown on pages read; a Contact page is linked but was not read.
